about:
American Iron Works operates from New Haven, Connecticut, where it has served clients for over 40 years. The business began as a passion project of Pasquale, the father and grandfather of the current owners, and has grown into a third-generation family-owned and operated shop now led by Anthony and Joe Maresca.

The company produces custom ornamental metal fabrications in iron, stainless steel, aluminum, and bronze. Its capabilities span welding (stick, MIG, and TIG), metal craft (manual grinding, cutting, chamfering, bending, punching, shearing, and plasma cutting), and finishing (sandblasting, powder coating, galvanizing, and patinas). The team manages projects from material sourcing through fabrication, finishing, and installation.

American Iron Works serves both commercial and residential customers throughout Connecticut. Commercial projects include structural ironwork, partition walls, and fire-escape renovations, while residential work covers railings, gates, balconies, pergolas, and decorative pieces such as CNC plasma-cut sunbursts and hand-forged branch-design rails.

The Maresca brothers attribute the firm’s reputation to fine craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to custom work that reflects each client’s aesthetic. The business was founded on a passion for metal craft and a desire to pass the trade down to future generations.
